reviews.title: Good notebook for everyday use
reviews.body: I have had this notebook for about 5 months which I use in mainly for e-mails/browsing sharing the on screen time with my ipad and I am pleased with the overall performance in terms of speed and ease of set up and use.It is easier to do some tasks on a note book like printing off documents so I hope
